item.title: What Is Krea Agent? A Plain Guide to Krea
item.description: Krea Agent is an AI agent for creative production. You describe the work, it picks the models, generates images, video and audio, edits the results, and files them in a shared context library. Here is what it does, how it works, who gets it, and where it stops.
